caption: The drawing depicts a figure kneeling on a cushioned mat. The mat is rectangular and appears to be a soft purple-brown with lighter marbling. The figure is dressed in clothing with intricate patterns and vivid colors: the flowing garments feature yellow, blue, and gold, with floral and vine designs in black and orange, and wide blue bands on the lower half. The figure also wears a striped turban, predominantly blue and beige, and a necklace consisting of three strings of red beads. The footwear is tan with a pointed shape. The right hand of the figure holds a golden or brass vessel with a pointed lid above another small cup-like item, both of which appear to be made of metal. The left hand holds a round tray, possibly silver or gold in color. The face and some parts of the arms and hands are left uncolored and undrawn, showing only faint pencil outlines. The background of the drawing is a plain, light off-white or ivory shade.
title: Sculpture
